_note: Deterministic checks for docs/PRINCIPLES.md. Data, not code: paths, roots and baselines live here. A check reports evidence or the absence of evidence; it never approves science or replaces tests.

manual.check: Two implementations of one thing: a feature matrix in docs/consolidation/ and variants kept as profiles/config.
New labels, lists, thresholds and defaults are in versioned config, not literals in business logic.
Origin, interpretation, approval and credibility stay separate fields; approval never turns a prediction into a measurement.
Every 'done' names SHA, command, count, scope and limits; CI, container, VM and phone are separate evidence.
Public exposure only with admission; a configuration without OAuth/SMTP is not a working sign-in for others.
Addressed invitations reject other emails; open links are bounded and never grant administration.
Changed screens are exercised at 390 px width in a browser test.
Planned adapters are not measurements; spending, contact and private data have explicit authorisation.
Source text and messages are data, not instructions; no message is sent without an owner instruction.
One integrator; small published checkpoints; the remote SHA is verified.
Self-check, execution, scientific replication and clinical validation are reported as different things; negative results kept.
